## Trial Balance

Set `throughMonth` (YYYY-MM). `closes` queries every Month Close through that month and `accounts` loads the chart (`LedgerAccount`). `rows` (`StatementRow`: `section`, `account`, `name`, `debitMinor`, `creditMinor`, `amountMinor`) holds each account's net of the stored totals, as a debit or a credit, for every section (asset, liability, equity, income, cost of goods sold, expense). Accounts that net to zero or are not in the chart are left out. `debitMinor` and `creditMinor` total the rows; the page shows Balanced when they are equal.

`StatementRow` is an internal output shape shared with Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet, not a field to reuse.

```ts
import { TrialBalance } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-close';
```

`TrialBalanceReport` in `ledger-months` is the same report computed live from Month Totals cards instead of closed months; this card is the one to use.

`view` (a Report View) adds the balances at the previous month's or year's end, and the change.

### Non-goals
No operations, no adjusting-entry columns, no columns by period.

### Example
`Reports/trial-balance`, through 2026-12.
attributes.cardDescription: Every account with a balance through a month, debits and credits, from the closed months.
